claims.claim: Israel's companies search page (Rasham HaChevarot / Rashut HaTagidim) is https://ica.justice.gov.il/GenericCorporarionInfo/SearchCorporation?unit=8 and it lets you search by corporation number or corporation name, free of charge.
claims.raw_snippet: ניתן לחפש לפי מספר תאגיד או שם תאגיד. המידע כאמור, ניתן ללא עלות וכשירות לציבור.
claims.method: Fetched the search page directly; the quoted sentence is the page's own description of the free public search.

claims.claim: Basic company information is free on the registrar (company number, name, type, limited or not, legal status, address, purpose, annual fee debts, and whether the company was declared in breach of the law); the full company extract is paid.
claims.raw_snippet: There are two categories of information, free information such as company number, name, type, (limited or not) legal status, address, purpose, description, annual fee debts if any, whether the company has been declared in breach or violation of the law (mainly on technical matters).
claims.method: Legalmondo Israel company-information guide (author Benjamin Leventhal), last updated 3 October 2025.

claims.claim: The full company extract (nesach chevra) costs a fee of roughly 15 EUR, and the basic information is also available online at the gov.il company_extract service page.
claims.raw_snippet: The additional category (available for a fee of 15€) provides the possibility to view a full company extract, that includes various detailed information concerning the company, including the company history of shareholders and directors, the composition of capital, technical changes, details of current and past directors, current shareholders, banking attachments of collateral, and liens.
claims.method: Same Legalmondo guide; the 15 EUR figure is the price stated for the full extract.

claims.claim: The gov.il service page for the company extract is https://www.gov.il/en/service/company_extract, and the registrar's actual search engine and extract content are in Hebrew only.
claims.raw_snippet: The initial interface of said website is available also in English, Arabic, Russian, Spanish and French, However the actual search engine is only in Hebrew as well as the substance of the corporate extract & materials (unless materials were actively submitted by a company in another language).
claims.method: Same Legalmondo guide. The page links the service as: Most of basic information It is available also online at: https://www.gov.il/en/service/company_extract

claims.claim: Chevra Baam (Ltd.) incorporation fee is 3,123 NIS, reduced by more than 500 NIS for an online filing, so the final amount is 2,559 NIS.
claims.raw_snippet: עלות אגרת רישום חברה עומדת על 3,123 ₪. אנו מגישים את הבקשה באופן מקוון ולכן אפשר להנות מהנחה של מעל 500 ₪, כך שהמחיר הסופי הוא 2,559 ₪ לאחר ההנחה.

claims.claim: The Ministry of Justice companies register carries a status field plus a separate breach-of-law flag; published statuses include active (pe'ila), in liquidation (be-piruq), struck off (nimekhqa) and the mafira (in breach) marking.
claims.raw_snippet: הקובץ מכיל את רשימת החברות הרשומות במרשם שמנהל רשם החברות כולל חברות בסטטוס: פעילה, פעילה/בפירוק - בכינוס נכסים, פעילה/בפירוק - הליך פשרה או הסדר/פירוק זמני, בפרוק מרצון, בפרוק ע"י בימ"ש, מחוקה, מחוסלת מרצון, חיסול ע"י בימ"ש, מחוסלת עקב מיזוג, פעילה זמנית, נגרעה מהמרשם.
claims.method: CKAN package_show for the Ministry of Justice ica_companies dataset (readable equivalent of the JS-rendered dataset page).

claims.claim: The Ministry of Justice publishes the registrar's bulk companies file as the CKAN dataset ica_companies on data.gov.il (dataset page https://data.gov.il/dataset/ica_companies). Per company it records the corporation number, name, type, status, sub-status, purpose, incorporation date, breach marking (mafira) and annual report.
claims.raw_snippet: הקובץ כולל את מספר התאגיד, שם התאגיד, שם התאגיד באנגלית, סוג התאגיד, סטטוס התאגיד, תת סטטוס התאגיד, תיאור התאגיד, מטרת התאגיד, תאריך התאגדות, מגבלות, מפרה, דוח שנתי וכתובת.
claims.method: Same CKAN record; the dataset is titled מאגר חברות - רשם החברות and is maintained by datagov_support@justice.gov.il.

claims.claim: GuideStar (guidestar.org.il) is the Ministry of Justice corporations site used for amutot and public-benefit companies.
claims.raw_snippet: גיידסטאר - אתר התאגידים של ישראל | משרד המשפטים
claims.method: Page title served at guidestar.org.il/home. The rest of the site is JS-rendered, so only the title is readable without a browser.

claims.claim: Israel has no operational UBO registry: a Ministry of Justice law memorandum was published on 26 June 2025 for public response, with comments due until 17 July 2025, and the path to legislation is still long.
claims.raw_snippet: On June 26, 2025 the Israeli Ministry of Justice published for public response a law memorandum with regard to the establishment of a national central registry of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) in corporations
claims.method: LIPA & Co corporate-law newsletter, 7 July 2025. Same page states the public could respond until July 17, 2025, and that the path to legislation and enforcement is still long.

claims.claim: A UBO under the Israeli memorandum is an individual holding 25% or more of any means of control, or otherwise exercising effective control.
claims.raw_snippet: A UBO is defined as an individual who has the ability to direct the corporation’s activities, directly or indirectly, including holding 25% or more of any control means, or otherwise exercising effective control.

claims.claim: When enacted, the Israeli UBO registry will not be publicly accessible.
claims.raw_snippet: It is important to note that the registry itself will not be publicly accessible.
claims.method: White and Partners summary of the Israeli Ministry of Justice UBO proposal.

claims.claim: Insolvency files are searchable at insolvency.justice.gov.il/poshtim/main/tikim/wfrmlisttikim.aspx, by debtor ID, debtor surname, the Commissioner's case number, or the court case number.
claims.raw_snippet: ניתן לערוך חיפוש לפי כל אחת מהאפשרויות הבאות: מספר ת.ז. של החייב, שם משפחת החייב, מס' התיק בממונה על חדלות פירעון, מס' התיק בבית המשפט.

claims.claim: The official title under the Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law 5778-2018 is 'ha-memuneh' (the Commissioner of Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Proceedings), appointed under section 266 of that law.
claims.raw_snippet: " הממונה " – הממונה על הליכי חדלות פירעון ושיקום כלכלי שמונה לפי סעיף 266;
claims.method: Definitions section (section 4) of חוק חדלות פירעון ושיקום כלכלי, תשע"ח-2018 on Nevo.

claims.claim: The Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law 5778-2018 took effect 18 months after publication and applies to proceedings commenced on or after that commencement day.
claims.raw_snippet: תחילתו של חוק זה 18 חודשים מיום פרסומו (להלן – יום התחילה), והוא יחול על הליכים לפי חוק זה שהחלו ביום התחילה ואילך.
claims.method: Section 373(a) of the law on Nevo. NOTE: the law text states the 18-month rule, not the calendar date; the skill's '15 September 2019' date is NOT evidenced by this source.

claims.claim: Liquidation and dissolution information about companies is published by the state, both on the registrar side and through the insolvency commissioner's site, which replaced what used to be the national Official Receiver.
claims.raw_snippet: Additionally, liquidation information is available under the website of the National Insolvency and Fiscal Rehabilitation Supervisor (the equivalent to what used to be the national "Official Receiver")
claims.method: Legalmondo Israel guide. This backs the rename of the Official Receiver function, but not the 2019-09-15 calendar date.

claims.claim: A company or partnership registered with the Corporations Authority owes an annual fee per calendar year. The reduced fee of 1,338 NIS is payable until 31.03.2026; from 01.04.2026 the standard rate of 1,777 NIS applies.
claims.raw_snippet: אגרה שנתית חברות: ניתן לשלם אגרה מופחתת בסך 1,338 ש"ח עד ל-31.03.2026. החל מה-01.04.2026 התעריף יעודכן לתעריף הרגיל בסך של 1,777 ש"ח.

claims.claim: A registered partnership pays a separate annual fee from a company: reduced 1,333 NIS until 31.03.2026, standard 1,771 NIS from 01.04.2026.
claims.raw_snippet: אגרה שנתית שותפויות: ניתן לשלם אגרה מופחתת בסך 1,333 ש"ח עד ל- 31.03.2026. החל מה-01.04.2026 התעריף יעודכן לתעריף הרגיל בסך של 1,771 ש"ח.

claims.claim: Section 126(a) of the Income Tax Ordinance imposes corporate tax on a body of persons' taxable income at 23%.
claims.raw_snippet: מס חברות 126. (א) על הכנסתו החייבת של חבר בני-אדם יוטל מס שייקרא "מס חברות", בשיעור של 23%.

claims.claim: Section 121(a) sets individual income-tax brackets, with 47% applying to each additional shekel above 560,280 NIS.
claims.raw_snippet: 121. (א) המס על הכנסתו החייבת של יחיד בשנת המס יהיה כלהלן: (1) על כל שקל חדש מ-301,200 השקלים החדשים הראשונים – 31%; (2) על כל שקל חדש מ-301,201 שקלים חדשים עד 560,280 שקלים חדשים – 35%; (3) על כל שקל חדש נוסף – 47%.
